Glad it's useful. One catch: **my last response got cut off** mid-budget table. These pieces you asked for never arrived:

Here they are, plus two corrections.

### Corrections to the earlier checklist
- **Oregon emissions (DEQ) testing** applies to the **Portland metro and Medford–Ashland areas only**, not Klamath Falls.
- **Oregon requires an out-of-state VIN inspection** at registration, and new residents generally must register within **30 days**. Plan a DMV visit early.
- **Driving time:** Ohio to Oregon is about 2,400 miles and 35–38 hours of driving. With a dog, plan **4–5 days and 3–4 lodging nights**, not 2–3.
- **Summer is peak moving season.** Book your movers, truck, or container this week. July 4th weekend inventory goes fast.

## Budget (continued)

| Item | Estimate | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Contingency fund | 10–15% of total | Recommended |
| Interim gear (air mattress, kitchen basics) | $100–$250 | Interstate movers often deliver **7–21 days** after pickup |
| Storage (if delivery and lease don't align) | $150–$400/mo | Often offered by the mover |

**Ballpark totals (1–2 bedrooms, one car driven, dog, excluding rent and deposits)**

| Option | Ballpark total |
|---|---|
| DIY truck (with car tow or 2nd driver) | **$3,500–$6,500** |
| Portable container + drive car | **$4,000–$7,000** |
| Hybrid (you pack, movers load and haul) | **$4,500–$8,000** |
| Full-service movers | **$7,500–$14,000+** |
| Add: ship a 2nd car (open carrier) | +$1,000–$1,500 |

## Services and Subscriptions Timeline

| Service | Ohio: cancel/stop | Oregon: start | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Electric/gas | Day after move | Day before arrival | M |
| Water/trash/sewer | Day after move (often via landlord) | Arrival day | M |
| Internet | Move day (return equipment!) | **Book now** for arrival day | P |
| USPS forwarding | Submit 2 wks before; start move day | — | J |
| Renter's/home insurance | Day after move | Day you get keys | P |
| Auto insurance | Update address on arrival; OR policy before registering | — | M |
| Gym, local memberships | Give notice 30 days out (check contracts) | — | Each |
| Streaming/apps | Update billing address; no cancel needed | — | P |
| Grocery/meal/pet food delivery | Pause week 1 out | Restart at new address | P |
| Banks, cards, employer payroll, IRS (Form 8822) | 2 weeks out | — | Each |
| Pharmacy | Transfer prescriptions 1 week out to a chain with OR locations | — | Each |
| Doctors/dentist | Request records 3–4 weeks out | Find new providers post-move | Each |

## Packing

**Timeline**
- **Weeks 8–6:** Declutter. Sell, donate, or toss.
- **Weeks 5–4:** Pack rarely used items: storage, off-season clothes, books, decor.
- **Weeks 3–2:** Pack guest room, most of the kitchen, and most closets.
- **Week 1:** Pack everything except essentials. Pack an "Open First" box per person and one for the dog.
- **Moving day:** Load the essentials kit, documents, and valuables into the car.

**Room-by-room**
- **Kitchen (P):** Wrap dishes and stand plates on edge. Pack one "camp kitchen" box: pan, 2 plates, utensils, knife, coffee setup, dish soap. Use up pantry food and freezer contents.
- **Bedrooms (J):** Use wardrobe boxes for hanging clothes. Pack 1 week of clothes per person in suitcases. Bag and label bed hardware and tape it to the frame.
- **Bathrooms (M):** Seal liquids in zip bags. Keep meds and toiletries in your personal bag.
- **Living room (J):** Photograph TV and electronics wiring before unplugging. Use original boxes if you have them. Remove and label furniture legs.
- **Office (P):** Back up computers. Carry laptops and hard drives yourself. Shred old paperwork.
- **Garage (M):** Movers won't take hazmat. Dispose of paint, propane, gasoline, aerosols, and cleaners. Drain mower and tool fuel.
- **Dog (M):** Pack a dog bag for the car (see below). Food, bed, and toys travel with you, not the truck.

**Declutter tips**
- Move cost scales with weight. If an item is worth less than about $1/lb to replace, consider selling it.
- Use the "not used in 12 months" rule for clothes, kitchen gadgets, and books.
- Sell big items early (weeks 8–5) on Facebook Marketplace. Schedule a donation pickup for week 3.
- Label every box with the **room, a contents summary, and a number**. Keep an inventory list on your phone.

## Consolidated Dog Checklist (M unless noted)
- [ ] Vet visit: exam, records copy, rabies certificate, meds refill (30+ days' supply)
- [ ] Ask the vet about anti-anxiety or motion-sickness meds. Do a trial dose before the trip.
- [ ] Microchip number on file. Update the registry on arrival.
- [ ] Tag with your cell number. Photo of the dog on your phone.
- [ ] Book pet-friendly hotels for every night. Confirm the pet fee and size limits by phone.
- [ ] Car setup: crate or crash-tested harness, seat cover, sunshade
- [ ] Car bag: food (plus extra), water jug, collapsible bowls, leash and spare, poop bags, meds, treats, chews, towels, enzyme cleaner, bed or blanket, favorite toy
- [ ] Moving day: keep the dog boarded or at a friend's (**P** arranges), or crated in a quiet room
- [ ] Save emergency vets along the route and at destination
- [ ] Post-move: new vet visit, county dog license, and walk the new neighborhood on leash for the first week

## 🖨️ Moving Day Essentials (Keep in the Car)

**DOCUMENTS FOLDER**
☐ Driver's licenses ☐ Vehicle title(s), registration, insurance cards
☐ Lease or closing docs (old + new) ☐ Mover contract, Bill of Lading, inventory
☐ Dog rabies cert, vaccine records, microchip # ☐ Prescriptions list ☐ Passports/SS cards/birth certs
☐ Hotel confirmations ☐ Emergency contacts printed (mover, landlord, vets)

**MONEY & TECH**
☐ Wallets, cards, some cash ☐ Phones + chargers + car charger ☐ Laptops/hard drives ☐ Keys (new place)

**PERSONAL**
☐ Meds (all of you) ☐ Suitcase: 5–7 days of clothes ☐ Toiletries ☐ Glasses/contacts
☐ Toilet paper, paper towels ☐ Snacks, water ☐ Sheets, pillows, towel per person

**DOG**
☐ Crate/harness ☐ Leash + spare ☐ Food + bowls ☐ Water jug ☐ Meds ☐ Poop bags
☐ Bed/blanket + toy ☐ Treats/chews ☐ Towels + enzyme cleaner ☐ Tag with cell #

**CAR & TOOLS**
☐ Tire gauge, jumper cables ☐ First-aid kit ☐ Flashlight ☐ Box cutter, tape, Sharpie
☐ Screwdriver, Allen keys ☐ Trash bags ☐ Bed-hardware bag ☐ Shower curtain + rings

**BEFORE LEAVING THE OLD PLACE**
☐ Final walkthrough video ☐ Meter photos ☐ Check closets, cabinets, attic, garage
☐ Bill of Lading reviewed and signed (no blanks) ☐ Keys returned + receipt
☐ Thermostat set, lights off, windows locked

**ON THE ROAD**
☐ Dog break every 2–3 hrs ☐ Never leave the dog in a parked car ☐ Log mileage, fuel, receipts
